entries.en: to be able; can; to know how (to do)
entries.notes: 西栏读音转写 ey/cy 存疑，惟 Poder＋會＋ey 互证，取“会、能够”义

entries.en: to be able; can
to be able to accomplish; to overcome, subdue; to restrain
entries.notes: 词尾 cycho it./vycho it. 转写未定，不碍释义；据 克(khek) 与 poder 词族取“能、克成”义

entries.zh: 胜过；战胜；能取胜、办得成
entries.en: to prevail over; to defeat, win; to manage
entries.notes: 官话栏 sobxuyuya/sobrequya 转写存疑；据 勝(sèng) 取“胜过”义

entries.zh: 堪任，胜任；经得起，承受得住；可派用场
entries.en: to be fit for; able to endure; worthy of use
entries.notes: 西语词尾 s 存疑；'poder ser de provecho（可派用场）'语境下取 堪 之“胜任”义

entries.en: usable; serviceable, fit for use
fit to be; worthy to serve as
to be able to do; can be done
entries.notes: 末字 ter/tit 转写存疑（得字读音），释义不变

entries.zh: 事能谐成；事情办得成，说合得妥
entries.en: the matter can be settled or accomplished; to come to terms

entries.zh: 能对付得了他；有办法奈何他
entries.en: to be able to cope with someone; to get the better of him
entries.notes: 汉字五字而闽南音仅四节（tay↔伊 对音不协）；据 L 栏 poder con algunos 将“有法伊奈何”解为“能奈何得了他”，存疑点

entries.en: to be able to despise; to look down on
entries.notes: 首字 貌/藐 之疑，据 menospreciar 取“藐视”义

entries.en: to be able to obtain by asking; can beg and get

entries.zh: 有财力的；富有，财力雄厚
entries.en: powerful (through wealth); rich, wealthy
to be able to deceive; to get away with deceiving
entries.notes: 西栏 poderoso 与汉栏欺過义不协，疑串行错位；释义据 欺過(gui-kue)“骗得过”义暂定，词头归属存疑

entries.zh: 脓；疮痍化脓（词头 Pode 当为 podre）
entries.en: pus; festering sore (podre)
entries.notes: 词头 Pode 系 podre 之截写；膿/腴 之疑据 podre 语境取“膿”

entries.zh: 手脚溃烂的湿疮；湿气疹
entries.en: festering sores of hands and feet; damp rash
entries.notes: 疹/疢 之疑；podre de pies y manos 指手脚湿烂之疮

entries.en: rotten; decayed; overdone to mush

entries.zh: 厌恶；腐坏得令人恶心、吃腻
entries.en: loathsome; to loathe, be sick of (rotten food)
entries.notes: 闽南音 aihu 与 厭 常规读音不协，或有讹字；据 podrido 语境取“厌恶”义

entries.en: rotten; mushy, pulpy
entries.notes: 首字 攬/覽 之疑，podrido 语境当为爛（lām）之别写

entries.en: (of food) spoiled, gone off; foul-smelling
entries.notes: 殕/殠 之疑；汉栏单字而闽南音两节（au chau），或为“殕臭”连读

entries.en: rotten, decayed; wasted away
entries.notes: 靡/縻 之疑，据 podrido 取“靡烂”义
